prompt_html: True or false: The maximum loss on a long call position is equal to the value of the premium paid.

An investor pays a $1.00 premium for a call option with a $60.00 strike price when the underlying price was trading at $55.00. At expiration the stock has increased to $65.00. What is the profit or loss on the option at expiration?

An investor pays a $1.75 premium for a call option with a $30.00 strike price when the underlying price was trading at $27.50. At expiration the stock has increased to $29.00. What is the profit or loss on the option at expiration?
What is the profit on a long call at expiration which ends $10.00 in the money for which the investor paid a premium of $5.00?
